ops.text: TestRelayMirrorFidelity (internal/ptyrelay/relay_test.go:87-96) is an intermittent PTY-output flake on cc-pool main CI. Root cause (ci-triage 2026-07-19): the test spawns /bin/echo on a real PTY via ptyrelay.Relay and asserts the mirrored output contains 'hello world', but Relay.Wait() (relay.go:117-150) can return err==nil with the mirrored output completely EMPTY — a PTY buffer-drain race between the short-lived child's exit and the master-side read loop, aggravated under loaded/virtualized CI runners. Confirmed pre-existing + baseline-flaky: same failure (same file:line, same message) on run 29533804627 (commit 4ff8a25a, 2026-07-16, a prek-config change) with many green runs interspersed, none touching ptyrelay. NOT caused by the daemonkit-migration CHANGELOG commit c6c3e2d4 (docs-only) that surfaced it. Needs a real root-cause of the PTY read/close ordering (a design/timing decision, not a mechanical fix); likely affects sibling relay_test.go cases using the same harness. Owner decision.
